questions.question: Which of the following countries has the highest Hindu population after India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Nepal is the country with the highest Hindu population after India.
 
• Approximately 81.3% of Nepal's population adheres to Hinduism.
 
• Nepal is the only Hindu countries in the world.
 
• Hinduism is deeply integrated into Nepalese culture, with numerous festivals, temples, and traditions rooted in the religion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindu Population**

 
 
• **India:** India has the largest Hindu population in the world, with over 79.8% of its population adhering to Hinduism, which translates to around 1.2 billion people.
 
• **Nepal:** As mentioned, Nepal has the highest Hindu population after India. The majority religion in Nepal is Hinduism.
 
• **Bangladesh:** Bangladesh has a significant Hindu minority, making up about 8-10% of the population, which translates to approximately 12-15 million people.
 
• **Indonesia:** Indonesia, primarily a Muslim-majority country, has a Hindu minority, primarily in Bali, constituting about 1.7% of its population.
 
 
 
• **Hinduism**
 
 
• Hinduism is one of the oldest religions in the world, with its origins tracing back more than 4,000 years.
 
• It is a complex faith characterized by a variety of beliefs, practices, and rituals.
 
• Key concepts in Hinduism include Dharma (duty/ethics), Karma (action and subsequent reaction), and Moksha (liberation from the cycle of rebirth).
 
• Hinduism is polytheistic, with a vast array of gods and goddesses, the most prominent being Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about the aims of National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA) of India is/are correct?

1. To make agriculture more productive.

2. To make agriculture more sustainable.

3. To promote organic farming.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1, 2 and 3 are correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The National Mission for Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA) aims to make agriculture more productive, sustainable, remunerative, and climate-resilient by promoting location-specific integrated/composite farming systems.
 
• It also focuses on improving soil health and water use efficiency, as well as enhancing seed quality and promoting the use of organic farming practices.
 
• The NMSA is designed to cover both rainfed and irrigated areas to ensure comprehensive coverage of all agricultural zones.
 
• It supports the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices that help in conserving natural resources while maintaining agricultural productivity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Soil Health Management (SHM)**

 
 
• SHM is one of the major components of the NMSA. It aims to promote Integrated Nutrient Management (INM) through judicious use of chemical fertilizers, including secondary and micronutrients, in conjunction with organic manure and bio-fertilizers.
 
• The objective is to improve soil health and its productivity, thus supporting sustainable agriculture.
 
 
 
• **Rainfed Area Development (RAD)**
 
 
• RAD focuses on Integrated Farming Systems (IFS) for enhancing productivity and minimizing risks associated with climatic variability.
 
• It includes crop diversification, horticulture, livestock, fishery, and agroforestry to make agriculture more resilient to climate change.
 
 
 
• **Climate Change and Sustainable Agriculture: Monitoring, Modeling and Networking (CCSAMMN)**
 
 
• This initiative aims to build and strengthen the capacity of farmers and other stakeholders in addressing climate change impacts on agriculture.
 
• It involves the development of climate-resilient agricultural practices and technologies, and promoting their adoption.
 
 
 
• **Organic Farming**
 
 
• The NMSA promotes organic farming through the Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY). PKVY aims to support and encourage farmers to adopt organic farming practices and certifications.
 
• It also focuses on marketing organic produce to ensure better returns to farmers.

questions.question: What is subtracted from GDP to arrive at NDP?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Depreciation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Depreciation refers to the reduction in the value of assets over time due to wear and tear, obsolescence, or other factors.
 
• In national accounting, GDP (Gross Domestic Product) measures the total economic output of a country.
 
• NDP (Net Domestic Product) is derived by subtracting the depreciation of the country's capital assets from its GDP.
 
• This adjustment is necessary to account for the loss in value of fixed capital and provides a more accurate measure of economic performance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)**

 
 
• GDP is the total market value of all final goods and services produced within a country's borders in a given time period.
 
• It is used to gauge the economic performance of a country and make international comparisons.
 
• GDP can be calculated using three approaches: the production (or output or value added) approach, the income approach, and the expenditure approach.
 
 
 
• **Net Domestic Product (NDP)**
 
 
• NDP is calculated by subtracting depreciation from GDP.
 
• Depreciation, also known as the consumption of fixed capital, reflects the wear and tear or obsolescence of physical assets.
 
• NDP provides a clearer picture of the actual economic performance by accounting for the decrease in value of capital goods.
 
 
 
• **Subsidies**
 
 
• Subsidies are financial assistance provided by the government to individuals, businesses, or other entities to promote economic and social policy objectives.
 
• They can take various forms, including direct cash transfers, tax breaks, or price controls.
 
 
 
• **Net Indirect Taxes**
 
 
• Net Indirect Taxes are calculated as indirect taxes (like sales tax, VAT) minus subsidies.
 
• They are part of the factor cost adjustment to reach market prices in national accounting.
 
 
 
• **Net Factor Income from Abroad**

• The term **Follow On** is used exclusively in the format of **Test cricket**.
 
• It occurs when a team, batting second, fails to avoid the follow on by scoring a certain percentage of the first team's score, usually **200 runs fewer** than the first team in a 5-day test match.
 
• The captain of the first batting team has the option to enforce the follow on, making the second team bat again immediately.
 
• This rule is designed to expedite the outcome of a match and is unique to Test cricket, emphasizing the strategic depth of this format.

• It is considered the ultimate test of playing ability and endurance, with matches often swinging back and forth in momentum.
 
• Introduced in 1877, Test cricket is the oldest form of the game and is played between international teams that are full members of the International Cricket Council (ICC).
 
• The follow on rule adds a strategic layer, where teams must decide whether to enforce it based on match conditions, player fitness, and weather forecasts.

• There is no follow on in ODIs as each team gets only one innings to bat.

• **T20 Cricket**
 
 
• T20 cricket is the shortest form of the game, with each team playing a maximum of 20 overs.
 
• It is designed to be completed in about three hours, providing a quick and entertaining format for spectators.
 
• There is no follow on in T20 cricket, as each team has only one innings.

questions.question: Which is a serious contagious bacterial infection that usually affects the mucous membranes of the nose and throat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Diphtheria**__.

*__Key Points__

__
 
• **Diphtheria** is a serious bacterial infection that usually affects the mucous membranes of the nose and throat.
 
• The disease is caused by the bacterium Corynebacterium diphtheriae*.
 
• Diphtheria spreads through respiratory droplets from coughing or sneezing.
 
• Symptoms include a thick, gray membrane covering the throat and tonsils, sore throat, swollen glands, and difficulty breathing.

• Meningococcal disease is caused by the bacterium Neisseria meningitidis*.
 
• It can lead to serious infections such as meningitis (inflammation of the membranes around the brain and spinal cord) and septicemia (blood poisoning).
 
• The disease spreads through respiratory droplets and close contact with an infected person.
 
• Symptoms include sudden fever, headache, and a stiff neck, often accompanied by nausea, vomiting, sensitivity to light, and altered mental status.

• Shigellosis is an infectious disease caused by a group of bacteria called *Shigella*.
 
• It is characterized by diarrhea (often bloody), fever, and stomach cramps.
 
• The infection spreads through contaminated food, water, or contact with an infected person.
 
• Good hygiene practices, especially handwashing, are critical for preventing the spread of Shigellosis.
 
 
 
• **Chlamydia**
 
 
• Chlamydia is a common sexually transmitted infection (STI) caused by the bacterium *Chlamydia trachomatis*.
 
• It can infect both men and women, causing damage to the reproductive system.
 
• Symptoms may include abnormal genital discharge and a burning sensation during urination.

questions.question: What was a significant negative environmental impact of the Green Revolution?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Soil degradation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Green Revolution led to the extensive use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, which resulted in the degradation of soil quality.
 
• Overuse of these chemicals destroyed beneficial soil microorganisms, making the soil less fertile over time.
 
• High-yielding varieties of crops required more water and nutrients, leading to the depletion of soil nutrients and increased soil salinity.
 
• Monocropping practices associated with the Green Revolution reduced the organic matter in the soil, further contributing to soil degradation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Green Revolution**

 
 
• The Green Revolution refers to a set of research, development, and technology transfer initiatives that increased agricultural production worldwide, particularly in developing countries, starting in the 1960s.
 
• Key components included the development of high-yielding varieties (HYVs) of staple crops, the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, and the introduction of modern farming techniques.
 
• The main aim was to achieve food security and reduce hunger by increasing crop yields.
 
 
 
• **Soil Degradation**
 
 
• Soil degradation is the decline in soil quality caused by its improper use, usually for agricultural, industrial, or urban purposes.
 
• It involves the loss of soil's physical, chemical, and biological properties, which affects its ability to sustain plant life and provide ecosystem services.
 
• Factors contributing to soil degradation include erosion, salinization, compaction, loss of soil organic matter, and contamination by toxic substances.
 
 
 
• **Chemical Fertilizers and Pesticides**
 
 
• Chemical fertilizers are substances that supply essential nutrients to plants in the form of compounds like nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium.
 
• Pesticides are chemicals used to kill or control pests that can damage crops.
 
• Excessive use of these chemicals can lead to environmental issues such as soil degradation, water pollution, and harm to non-target organisms.
 
 
 
• **Monocropping**
 
 
• Monocropping is the agricultural practice of growing the same crop on the same piece of land year after year.
 
• This practice can lead to soil nutrient depletion, increased vulnerability to pests and diseases, and reduced biodiversity.
 
• It often requires higher inputs of fertilizers and pesticides to maintain crop yields, contributing to soil degradation and environmental pollution.

questions.question: The chemical formula of glucose is C₆H₁₂O₆. The weight % of carbon in glucose is:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**40%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The chemical formula for glucose is C₆H₁₂O₆.
 
• The molar mass of glucose can be calculated by summing the molar masses of its constituent elements: Carbon (C), Hydrogen (H), and Oxygen (O).
 
• To find the percentage of carbon in glucose, the mass of carbon atoms in one mole of glucose is divided by the molar mass of glucose and then multiplied by 100.
 
• This gives the weight percentage of carbon in glucose as 40%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Molecular Formula**

 
 
• The molecular formula of a compound gives the exact number of atoms of each element in a molecule of the compound.
 
• For glucose, the molecular formula is C₆H₁₂O₆.
 
 
 
• **Molar Mass**
 
 
• The molar mass is the mass of one mole of a substance (chemical element or chemical compound).
 
• The molar masses of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen are approximately 12 g/mol, 1 g/mol, and 16 g/mol, respectively.
 
 
 
• **Percentage Composition by Mass**
 
 
• The percentage composition by mass of an element in a compound is the percentage by mass of that element in the compound.
 
• It is calculated as (mass of the element in 1 mole of the compound / molar mass of the compound) × 100.
 
 
 
• **Calculation of Weight % of Carbon in Glucose**
 
 
• The molar mass of glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆) = (6 × 12) + (12 × 1) + (6 × 16) = 180 g/mol.
 
• The mass of carbon in one mole of glucose = 6 × 12 = 72 g.
 
• Weight % of carbon in glucose = (72 g / 180 g) × 100 = 40%.

questions.question: Two candidates contested in an election. 80% of the voters cast their votes, out of which 5% of the polled votes were invalid. The winning candidate got 70% of valid votes and won by a majority of 36,480 votes. Find the total number of voters.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Majority = 70% − 30% = 40% of valid votes.

Total Voters × 80% × 95% × 40% = 36,480

Total Voters × (4/5) × (19/20) × (2/5) = 36,480

Total Voters × (152/500) = 36,480

Total Voters = 36,480 × (500 ÷ 152) = 1,20,000

**∴ The correct answer is 1,20,000 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Polled votes = 80% of total voters

Valid votes = 95% of polled votes

Winning candidate votes = 70% of valid votes

Majority = 36,480 votes

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0104a94791bc208969b79f345fe5b0434aae5fa0d7e023c6df7c37ea14337fd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the total number of voters be 100x.

⇒ Polled votes = 80% of 100x = 80x

⇒ Valid votes = 95% of 80x = 76x

⇒ Winner's share = 70% of 76x

⇒ Loser's share = (100% − 70%) = 30% of 76x

⇒ Majority = Winner's share − Loser's share

⇒ Majority = (70% − 30%) = 40% of 76x

⇒ Majority = 0.40 × 76x = 30.4x

⇒ 30.4x = 36,480

⇒ x = 36,480 ÷ 30.4 = 1,200

⇒ Total voters = 100x = 100 × 1,200 = 1,20,000

**∴ The correct answer is 1,20,000 voters.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Trick

When multiple percentage reductions occur consecutively (e.g., voters → polled → valid), the final value can be found by directly multiplying the base with their equivalent successive fractions: Final Value = Initial Base × (1 − r₁/100) × (1 − r₂/100).

Majority in Elections

The term "majority" exclusively represents the margin or the difference between the winning candidate's votes and the opposing candidate's votes. Majority % = (Winner % − Loser %) calculated out of valid votes only.

Valid vs Invalid Votes

Only the votes that are actively polled in the election can be considered for determining validity. Hence, Valid Votes = Polled Votes − Invalid Votes. Do not subtract invalid votes directly from the total voters list.
</p

questions.question: A motorboat takes 18 hours to go downstream, and it takes 36 hours to return the same distance. Find the ratio of the speed of the boat in still water to the speed of the stream.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed ratio is inverse of Time ratio.

Time Ratio (Downstream : Upstream) = 18 : 36 = 1 : 2 ⇒ Speed Ratio (D : U) = 2 : 1

Let Downstream Speed (D) = 2 and Upstream Speed (U) = 1

Speed of boat (B) = (D + U) ÷ 2 = 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5

Speed of stream (S) = (D − U) ÷ 2 = 1 ÷ 2 = 0.5

Ratio B : S = 1.5 : 0.5 = 3 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 1.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken downstream (Td) = 18 hours

Time taken upstream (Tᵤ) = 36 hours

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Downstream Speed = Speed of Boat in still water (B) + Speed of Stream (S)

Upstream Speed = Speed of Boat in still water (B) − Speed of Stream (S)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4eb55c1b49218e453e18382e7ae9511f33dc760b4386bd9f011447a2cde32faf.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the speed of the boat in still water be B and the speed of the stream be S.

⇒ Downstream speed = B + S

⇒ Upstream speed = B − S

⇒ Since the distance is constant in both directions, we equate the distances:

⇒ Distance = Downstream Speed × Downstream Time = Upstream Speed × Upstream Time

⇒ (B + S) × 18 = (B − S) × 36

⇒ Dividing both sides by 18, we get:

⇒ B + S = (B − S) × 2

⇒ B + S = 2B − 2S

⇒ 2S + S = 2B − B

⇒ 3S = B

⇒ Ratio of B to S = 3 : 1

**∴ The correct answer is 3 : 1.**

**__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If Downstream Speed is D and Upstream Speed is U, then the Speed of the Boat in still water B = (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

If Downstream Speed is D and Upstream Speed is U, then the Speed of the Stream S = (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed

When traveling equal distances downstream and upstream, the Average Speed = (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).
</p

questions.question: In right-angled triangle ABC, ∠C=90, CM is perpendicular on AB. If AB = 18 cm and BM = 6 cm, then find the length of CM.

In a right-angled triangle, the square of the altitude drawn to the hypotenuse equals the product of the two segments of the hypotenuse.

By Geometric Mean Theorem: CM² = AM × BM

Given AB = 18 cm and BM = 6 cm, we can find AM = 18 − 6 = 12 cm.

CM² = 12 × 6 = 72

CM = √72 = 6√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√2 cm.**

∠C = 90°

CM ⊥ AB

AB = 18 cm

BM = 6 cm

**Formula Used:**

When an altitude is drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse, the square of its length is the product of the lengths of the two segments it creates on the hypotenuse.

CM² = AM × BM

**Calculations:**

⇒ AB = AM + BM

⇒ 18 = AM + 6

⇒ AM = 18 − 6 = 12 cm

Now, substitute the values of AM and BM into the geometric mean formula:

⇒ CM² = 12 × 6

⇒ CM² = 72

⇒ CM = √72

⇒ CM = 6√2 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 6√2 cm.**

Altitude Rule

The altitude drawn to the hypotenuse is the geometric mean of the two hypotenuse segments (h² = x × y).

Leg Rule

Each leg of the right triangle is the geometric mean of the entire hypotenuse and the segment adjacent to that leg (a² = c × x and b² = c × y).

Area Equivalency

The product of the two legs equals the product of the hypotenuse and the altitude to the hypotenuse (a × b = c × h).

questions.question: Find the least value of x for which 57x716 is divisible by 9.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of its digits is a multiple of 9.

Sum of digits = 5 + 7 + x + 7 + 1 + 6 = 26 + x.

The nearest multiple of 9 greater than 26 is 27.

26 + x = 27 ⇒ x = 1.

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The number is 57x716, which is completely divisible by 9.

**Concept Used:**

For a number to be perfectly divisible by 9, the sum of all its digits must be a multiple of 9.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of the digits of 57x716 = 5 + 7 + x + 7 + 1 + 6

⇒ Sum = 26 + x

⇒ Possible values for (26 + x) that are multiples of 9 are 27, 36, 45, etc.

⇒ Since x is a single-digit positive integer (from 0 to 9), the maximum possible sum can be 26 + 9 = 35.

⇒ Therefore, the only possible multiple of 9 in this range is 27.

⇒ 26 + x = 27

⇒ x = 27 − 26 = 1

**∴ The correct answer is 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 3

A number is completely divisible by 3 if the sum of its digits is divisible by 3.

Divisibility Rule of 4

A number is divisible by 4 if the number formed by its last two digits is perfectly divisible by 4.

Divisibility Rule of 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of digits at odd positions and the sum of digits at even positions is 0 or a multiple of 11.

Divisibility Rule of 8

A number is divisible by 8 if the number formed by its last three digits is perfectly divisible by 8.
</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper allows 40% discount on his goods. He further gives 20% discount. What is the single discount equivalent to these two successive discounts?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the single equivalent discount is given by the formula:

Equivalent Discount = a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100

Here, a = 40 and b = 20

⇒ Equivalent Discount = 40 + 20 − (40 × 20) ÷ 100

⇒ Equivalent Discount = 60 − 8 = 52%

**∴ The correct answer is 52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First discount = 40%

Second discount = 20%

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23fca935572cb9d86be0d44b4e188ecbcb224b515426694e63d8a98984dd6445.png] 

**Calculations:**

Let the Marked Price (MP) of the goods be 100.

⇒ Price after 1st discount = 100 − (40% of 100) = 100 − 40 = 60

⇒ Price after 2nd discount (Selling Price) = 60 − (20% of 60) = 60 − 12 = 48

⇒ Total Discount = MP − SP = 100 − 48 = 52

⇒ Single Equivalent Discount % = (Total Discount ÷ MP) × 100

⇒ Equivalent Discount % = (52 ÷ 100) × 100 = 52%

**∴ The correct answer is 52%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount for Three Percentages

If three successive discounts d₁%, d₂%, and d₃% are given, the equivalent Single Discount is: 100 − [100 × (100−d₁)÷100 × (100−d₂)÷100 × (100−d₃)÷100].

Relation between CP and MP

When the profit percentage (P%) and discount percentage (D%) are known, the ratio of Marked Price (MP) to Cost Price (CP) is computed directly using the formula: MP/CP = (100 + P%) ÷ (100 − D%).

Buy X Get Y Free

If a shopkeeper offers 'Buy X, Get Y Free', the total items given to the customer are X + Y. The discount percentage is calculated as: Discount % = [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100.
</p

questions.question: If 8a³ + b³ + 27c³ = 18 abc, then the relation among a, b and c is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Standard Identity: If x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz, then x + y + z = 0.

Given equation: 8a³ + b³ + 27c³ = 18abc

Rewrite as: (2a)³ + (b)³ + (3c)³ = 3 × (2a) × (b) × (3c)

Here x = 2a, y = b, and z = 3c.

⇒ 2a + b + 3c = 0 ⇒ b + 3c = −2a

**∴ The correct answer is b + 3c = −2a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

8a³ + b³ + 27c³ = 18abc

**Formula Used:**

x³ + y³ + z³ − 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x² + y² + z² − xy − yz − zx)

If x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz, then either x + y + z = 0 or x = y = z.

**Calculations:**

⇒ The given expression can be arranged as follows by bringing all terms to one side:

⇒ 8a³ + b³ + 27c³ − 18abc = 0

⇒ Now, represent each term as a perfect cube:

⇒ (2a)³ + (b)³ + (3c)³ − 3 × (2a) × (b) × (3c) = 0

⇒ Comparing this directly with the algebraic identity, we can substitute x = 2a, y = b, and z = 3c.

⇒ According to the identity rule, for the expression to be zero, the sum of the base variables must be zero.

⇒ x + y + z = 0

⇒ 2a + b + 3c = 0

⇒ Moving 2a to the right side of the equation:

⇒ b + 3c = −2a

This strictly matches the relation given in the options.

**∴ The correct answer is b + 3c = −2a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Core Algebraic Identity

a³ + b³ + c³ − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca).

Conditional Cubes Identity

If a + b + c = 0, then substituting this into the main identity simplifies to a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc.

Sum of Squares Form

a² + b² + c² − ab − bc − ca = ½[(a − b)² + (b − c)² + (c − a)²].

Equality Condition

If a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc and a + b + c ≠ 0, it strictly means a = b = c.
</p

questions.question: An article passing through two hands is sold at a total profit of 40% of the original cost price. If the first dealer makes a profit of 30%, then the profit percentage made by the second dealer is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Let the original Cost Price = 100 units.

First dealer makes 30% profit ⇒ SP₁ = Cost Price for second dealer = 130 units.

Total profit is 40% on original Cost Price ⇒ Final SP = 140 units.

Profit for the second dealer = Final SP − CP₂ = 140 − 130 = 10 units.

Profit % for second dealer = (10 ÷ 130) × 100 = 100 ÷ 13 = 7 ⁹/₁₃ %.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 ⁹/₁₃ %.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total profit on the article = 40%

Profit made by the first dealer = 30%

**Formula Used:**

Successive Percentage Formula: Net Profit % = a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47cd05f8310788e8954a90ac418d9be49aefc4cadf17ac7b91e985dc2cd7833b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the profit percentage made by the second dealer be b.

⇒ By applying the successive percentage formula we equate it to the total profit of 40%.

⇒ 40 = 30 + b + (30 × b) ÷ 100

⇒ 40 − 30 = b + 0.3b

⇒ 10 = 1.3b

⇒ b = 10 ÷ 1.3 = 100 ÷ 13

⇒ b = 7 ⁹/₁₃ %

**∴ The correct answer is 7 ⁹/₁₃ %.**

**__Additional Information__**

Successive Profits

When an item is sold multiple times sequentially, the net profit percentage is calculated using the successive percentage formula: Net % = a + b + (a × b) ÷ 100.

Marked Price & Discount

Discount is always given on the Marked Price (MP). The resulting selling price is: SP = MP × (100 − Discount%) ÷ 100.

Dishonest Dealer

If a dealer sells goods at Cost Price but uses false weight, the actual profit percentage is calculated as: Profit % = (True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight × 100.
</p

questions.question: In a company, the ratio of men and women is 5 : 3, respectively. When 150 additional women are employed in the company, the ratio becomes 5 : 4. How many men are employed in the company?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Initial ratio of Men to Women = 5 : 3

Final ratio of Men to Women = 5 : 4

Men's ratio part (5) remains constant as only women are added.

Increase in women's ratio = 4 − 3 = 1 part.

1 part = 150 women ⇒ Men = 5 parts = 150 × 5 = 750.

**∴ The correct answer is 750 men.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial ratio of Men to Women = 5 : 3

Number of additional women employed = 150

Final ratio of Men to Women = 5 : 4

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c81339a6f9569ec37058e8b6553e0b9086ecda941167b76a0de4ecbb7d16302.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the initial number of men and women be 5x and 3x respectively.

⇒ After adding 150 women, the number of women becomes (3x + 150).

⇒ The new ratio of men to women is 5 : 4.

⇒ 5x / (3x + 150) = 5 / 4

⇒ 20x = 5 × (3x + 150)

⇒ 20x = 15x + 750

⇒ 20x − 15x = 750

⇒ 5x = 750

⇒ The number of men is 5x, which is exactly 750.

**∴ The correct answer is 750 men.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Compound Ratio

When two or more ratios are multiplied together, it is called a compound ratio. For individual ratios a : b and c : d, the compound ratio is ac : bd.

Duplicate & Triplicate Ratio

The duplicate ratio of a : b is a² : b². The triplicate ratio is a³ : b³.

Componendo and Dividendo

If a / b = c / d, then (a + b) / (a − b) = (c + d) / (c − d). This rule is very helpful in quickly solving proportional equations.

questions.question: If sin A + cos A = (1)/(2sqrt{2)}, then find the value of sin⁴A + cos⁴A.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If sin A + cos A = k, then we directly find sin A cos A = (k² − 1) ÷ 2.

Here, k = 1 / 2√2, so k² = 1 / 8.

sin A cos A = (1/8 − 1) ÷ 2 = −7 / 16.

We know the identity, sin⁴A + cos⁴A = 1 − 2(sin A cos A)².

Result = 1 − 2(−7 / 16)² = 1 − 2(49 / 256) = 1 − 49 / 128 = 79 / 128.

**∴ The correct answer is 79/128.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin A + cos A = 1 / 2√2

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

sin²A + cos²A = 1

a⁴ + b⁴ = (a² + b²)² − 2a²b²

**Calculations:**

Squaring both sides of the given equation:

⇒ (sin A + cos A)² = (1 / 2√2)²

⇒ sin²A + cos²A + 2 sin A cos A = 1 / 8

⇒ 1 + 2 sin A cos A = 1 / 8

⇒ 2 sin A cos A = 1/8 − 1

⇒ 2 sin A cos A = −7 / 8

⇒ sin A cos A = −7 / 16

Now, finding the value of sin⁴A + cos⁴A:

⇒ sin⁴A + cos⁴A = (sin²A + cos²A)² − 2 sin²A cos²A

⇒ sin⁴A + cos⁴A = 1² − 2(sin A cos A)²

⇒ sin⁴A + cos⁴A = 1 − 2(−7 / 16)²

⇒ sin⁴A + cos⁴A = 1 − 2(49 / 256)

⇒ sin⁴A + cos⁴A = 1 − 49 / 128

⇒ sin⁴A + cos⁴A = (128 − 49) / 128 = 79 / 128

**∴ The correct answer is 79/128.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of 4th Powers

sin⁴θ + cos⁴θ = 1 − 2 sin²θ cos²θ

Sum of 6th Powers

sin⁶θ + cos⁶θ = 1 − 3 sin²θ cos²θ

Difference to Sum Relation

If sin θ + cos θ = x, then sin θ − cos θ = ±√(2 − x²).
</p

questions.question: [ (4 cos(90 - theta) sin³(90 + theta) - 4 sin(90 + theta) cos³(90 - theta))/(cos(frac{180 + 8theta){2})} ] = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using basic reductions: cos(90° − θ) = sinθ and sin(90° + θ) = cosθ.

Numerator = 4sinθcos³θ − 4cosθsin³θ = 4sinθcosθ(cos²θ − sin²θ).

Using double angle formulas: Numerator = 2 × (2sinθcosθ) × cos2θ = 2sin2θcos2θ = sin4θ.

Denominator = cos(90° + 4θ) = −sin4θ.

Result = sin4θ ÷ (−sin4θ) = −1.

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

[4cos(90° − θ)sin³(90° + θ) − 4sin(90° + θ)cos³(90° − θ)] ÷ cos((180° + 8θ) ÷ 2)

**Formula Used:**

cos(90° − θ) = sinθ

sin(90° + θ) = cosθ

cos(90° + x) = −sinx

sin2x = 2sinxcosx

cos2x = cos²x − sin²x

**Calculations:**

⇒ Simplifying the numerator:

⇒ 4sinθcos³θ − 4cosθsin³θ

⇒ 4sinθcosθ(cos²θ − sin²θ)

⇒ 2 × (2sinθcosθ) × (cos²θ − sin²θ)

⇒ 2 × sin2θ × cos2θ

⇒ sin4θ

⇒ Simplifying the denominator:

⇒ cos(180° ÷ 2 + 8θ ÷ 2)

⇒ cos(90° + 4θ)

⇒ −sin4θ

⇒ Now, substituting both values into the given expression:

⇒ Expression = sin4θ ÷ (−sin4θ)

⇒ Expression = −1

**∴ The correct answer is -1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Signs in Quadrants (ASTC Rule)

Quadrant I (0° to 90°): All functions are positive.
Quadrant II (90° to 180°): Only sin and cosec are positive.
Quadrant III (180° to 270°): Only tan and cot are positive.
Quadrant IV (270° to 360°): Only cos and sec are positive.

Double Angle Formulas

sin2x = 2sinxcosx = (2tanx) ÷ (1 + tan²x)
cos2x = cos²x − sin²x = 2cos²x − 1 = 1 − 2sin²x

Complementary and Supplementary Angles

sin(90° − x) = cosx and cos(90° − x) = sinx
sin(180° − x) = sinx and cos(180° − x) = −cosx

questions.question: If a³ + 3a² + 3a = 7, then the value of a² + 2a is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

By adding 1 to both sides, the given expression becomes a perfect cube.

a³ + 3a² + 3a + 1 = 7 + 1

⇒ (a + 1)³ = 8

⇒ a + 1 = 2 ⇒ a = 1

Substitute a = 1 into a² + 2a ⇒ 1² + 2(1) = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

a³ + 3a² + 3a = 7

**Formula Used:**

(x + y)³ = x³ + y³ + 3x²y + 3xy²

**Calculations:**

We know that the given expression is very close to the expansion of (a + 1)³.

Add 1 to both sides of the equation to complete the perfect cube on the left side:

⇒ a³ + 3a² + 3a + 1 = 7 + 1

⇒ a³ + 3(a²)(1) + 3(a)(1)² + 1³ = 8

⇒ (a + 1)³ = 2³

Taking the cube root on both sides:

⇒ a + 1 = 2

⇒ a = 2 − 1 = 1

Now, substitute the value of a = 1 in the required expression a² + 2a:

⇒ (1)² + 2(1)

⇒ 1 + 2 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Perfect Cube Expansion

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b) = a³ + b³ + 3a²b + 3ab²

Negative Perfect Cube

(a − b)³ = a³ − b³ − 3ab(a − b) = a³ − b³ − 3a²b + 3ab²

Sum and Difference of Cubes

a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² − ab + b²) and a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + ab + b²)

questions.question: What is the rate of interest per annum for simple interest at which ₹1,040 amounts to ₹1,230 in 1(1)/(2) years?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Total Interest (SI) = Amount − Principal = 1230 − 1040 = ₹190.

Interest for 1 year = Total Interest ÷ Time = 190 ÷ 1.5 = 190 × (2/3) = ₹380/3.

Rate % = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Principal) × 100.

Rate % = (380/3 ÷ 1040) × 100 = 38000 ÷ 3120 = 475 ÷ 39 = 12 ⁷/₃₉ %.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 ⁷/₃₉ %.**

**__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8e6dd12e85c9cb48ee050a39e83abd0419b541ce0ae6d984a2bb9c84ae526eb.png] 

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹1040

Amount (A) = ₹1230

Time (T) = 1.5 years = 3/2 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = A − P

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ SI = 1230 − 1040 = ₹190

⇒ 190 = [1040 × R × (3/2)] ÷ 100

⇒ 190 = (520 × R × 3) ÷ 100

⇒ 190 × 100 = 1560 × R

⇒ 19000 = 1560 × R

⇒ R = 19000 ÷ 1560

⇒ R = 1900 ÷ 156

⇒ R = 475 ÷ 39 = 12 ⁷/₃₉ %

**∴ The correct answer is 12 ⁷/₃₉ %.**

**__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Amount Formula

The total amount after simple interest is accumulated over T years is calculated as A = P × [1 + (R × T) ÷ 100].

Compound Interest (CI)

In Compound Interest, interest is earned on both the principal and previously accumulated interest. Formula: A = P × (1 + R ÷ 100)T.

SI vs CI Difference

For a time period of 2 years, the difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest on the same principal and rate is given by D = P × (R ÷ 100)².

questions.question: If the height and diameter of a cylinder are 12 cm and 28 cm, respectively, then find the ratio of the total surface area to the curved surface area.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a given cylinder, the ratio of Total Surface Area (TSA) to Curved Surface Area (CSA) is derived directly as (h + r) / h.

Given, height (h) = 12 cm and diameter = 28 cm ⇒ radius (r) = 14 cm.

Required Ratio = (12 + 14) / 12

Required Ratio = 26 / 12 = 13 / 6

**∴ The correct answer is 13 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5128285cf3b45008639e6566ceed67d5b6c0bb017373b469e46f78baa6095c2.png] 

**Given:**

⇒ Height of the cylinder (h) = 12 cm

⇒ Diameter of the cylinder (d) = 28 cm

⇒ Radius (r) = d ÷ 2 = 28 ÷ 2 = 14 cm

**Formulas Used:**

⇒ Total Surface Area (TSA) = 2πr(h + r)

⇒ Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

⇒ Ratio = TSA ÷ CSA

⇒ Ratio = [2 × π × r × (h + r)] ÷ [2 × π × r × h]

⇒ Ratio = (h + r) ÷ h

⇒ Ratio = (12 + 14) ÷ 12

⇒ Ratio = 26 ÷ 12

⇒ Ratio = 13 ÷ 6

⇒ Ratio = 13 : 6

**∴ The correct answer is 13 : 6.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The capacity of a cylinder is calculated using the formula: Volume = πr²h.

Surface Area of a Cone

Curved Surface Area = πrl and Total Surface Area = πr(l + r), where slant height l = √(r² + h²).

Surface Area of a Sphere

The total curved surface of a sphere is given by Surface Area = 4πr².

**Correct Sentence:** *"A new bridge has been built across the river by them."*
